senses.gloss: (denom. of קֶלַח) to rise in a column.
to bring forth an uninterrupted jet, cause an uninterrupted flow; to splash.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 12a:9">Ab. Zar. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>פרצופות המְקַלְּחִין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01976"><he>פַּרְצוֹף</he></cite>. Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 23 <he>המְקַלֵּחַ</he>, v. <cite ref="R00613"><he>צִנּוֹר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 22a:31">Ker. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>כל זמן שמקלח</he> as long as the blood gushes forth, v. <cite ref="V00702"><he>תַּמְצִית</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause gushing forth by interposing an object, to dam in and cause an overflow.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 7:4">Eduy. VII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 25b:12">Zeb. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>זוחלין שקִילְּחָן וכ׳</he> dripping liquids caused to overflow in a continuous current by a dam of burs of nuts.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:5">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:5">XIII</cite>), 5; Y. ib. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ; Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 106b:9">ib. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>אם היו מְקַלְּחוֹת ובאות</he> if they come on in dense columns.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 3:2">Tosef. Shek. III, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 3:4">4</cite>, sq. <he>כהנים מקלחין אזתן</he> (Var. <he>מקבלין</he>) the priests collect these moneys (put them in a horn, v. <cite ref="U00509"><he>שׁוֹפָר</he></cite>).
